extra._nfcBuildNote: NFC tap-to-order (react-native-nfc-manager) requires a native build — it does NOT work in Expo Go. Use EAS Build to create a testable binary: `eas build --profile development --platform android` (sideloadable APK with dev client) or `eas build --profile preview --platform android` (internal-distribution APK for wider testing). Install eas-cli globally with `npm install -g eas-cli`, then authenticate with `eas login` and link the project with `eas project:init` before building. See eas.json in this directory for all available profiles (development, preview, production).
